claims.text: What the image looks like Coffee-bean / inverted-U sign pointing to RUQ → sigmoid volvulus (older, debilitated)
claims.quote: Coffee-bean / inverted-U sign pointing to RUQ Sigmoid volvulus (older, debilitated)

claims.text: Buzzword: coffee-bean / kidney-bean sign on AXR → sigmoid volvulus
claims.quote: Coffee-bean / kidney-bean sign AXR Sigmoid volvulus

claims.text: Buzzword: bird's beak on barium enema / CT → sigmoid volvulus / closed-loop obstruction
claims.quote: Bird's beak Barium enema / CT Sigmoid volvulus / closed-loop obstruction

claims.text: Aspects (abnormal in red) Large bowel: peripheral “picture frame”; haustra do NOT cross the full diameter; dilated > 6 cm (> 9 cm at the cecum)
claims.quote: Large bowel = peripheral 'picture frame', haustra do NOT cross full diameter, dilated >6 cm (>9 cm at cecum).

claims.text: Contrast enema: a “bird-beak” deformity at the twist; the enema may actually reduce a sigmoid volvulus
claims.quote: With both cecal and sigmoid volvulus, a contrast enema shows the site of obstruction by a typical “bird-beak” deformity at the site of the twist; the procedure may actually reduce a sigmoid volvulus.

claims.text: Causes Volvulus is a twisting of the colon around itself, sometimes causing strangulation with ischemia and necrosis
claims.quote: Volvulus is a twisting of the colon around itself, sometimes causing strangulation with ischemia and necrosis.

claims.text: Symptoms Often abrupt onset; continuous pain, sometimes with superimposed waves of colicky pain
claims.quote: Volvulus often has an abrupt onset. Pain is continuous, sometimes with superimposed waves of colicky pain.

claims.text: Treatment and next step Her chart: sigmoidoscopic decompression then sigmoidectomy
An endoscope or long rectal tube can often decompress the loop, and resection and anastomosis may be deferred a few days; without resection, recurrence is almost inevitable
claims.quote: In sigmoid volvulus, an endoscope or a long rectal tube can often decompress the loop, and resection and anastomosis may be deferred for a few days. Without a resection, recurrence is almost inevitable.

claims.text: If a contrast enema is not done, colonoscopy can decompress a sigmoid volvulus (it rarely works for cecal volvulus)
claims.quote: If contrast enema is not done, colonoscopy can be used to decompress a sigmoid volvulus but rarely works with a cecal volvulus.
